description:
MCP guidance:
- This only creates presigned upload URLs. For local files, upload the raw bytes to each returned `upload_url` outside the generation call, then pass the matching `file_path` into the create tool.
- For `*_file_path`, use an existing Magic Hour path or the upload-URL endpoint's `file_path` after uploading raw bytes to its presigned URL. Direct public media URLs may work if stable and fetchable as raw bytes; hotlinked URLs can fail. Prefer the upload-URL endpoint when unsure.

Generates a list of pre-signed upload URLs for the assets required. This API is only necessary if you want to upload to Magic Hour's storage. Refer to the [Input Files Guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/integration/inputs-and-outputs) for more details.

The response array will match the order of items in the request body.

**Valid file extensions per asset type**:
- video: mp4, m4v, mov, webm
- audio: mp3, wav, aac, flac, webm, weba, m4a, opus, ogg, oga, aiff, amr
- image: png, jpg, jpeg, jfif, heic, heif, webp, avif, jp2, tiff, tif, bmp
- gif: gif, webp, webm

> Note: `gif` is only supported for face swap API `video_file_path` field.

Once you receive an upload URL, send a `PUT` request to upload the file directly.

Example:

```
curl -X PUT --data '@/path/to/file/video.mp4' \
  https://videos.magichour.ai/api-assets/id/video.mp4?<auth params from the API response>
```

items.description: The list of assets to upload. The response array will match the order of items in the request body.

extension.description: The extension of the file to upload. Do not include the dot (.) before the extension. Possible extensions are mp4,m4v,mov,webm,mp3,wav,aac,flac,webm,weba,m4a,opus,ogg,oga,aiff,amr,png,jpg,jpeg,jfif,heic,heif,webp,avif,jp2,tiff,tif,bmp,gif,webp,webm

type.description: The type of asset to upload. Possible types are video, audio, image

name: video_assets_generate_presigned_url

items.description: The list of upload URLs and file paths for the assets. The response array will match the order of items in the request body. Refer to the [Input Files Guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/integration/inputs-and-outputs) for more details.

expires_at.description: when the upload url expires, and will need to request a new one.

file_path.description: this value is used in APIs that needs assets, such as image_file_path, video_file_path, and audio_file_path

upload_url.description: Used to upload the file to storage, send a PUT request with the file as data to upload.

title: Generate asset upload urls
